name: mageaustralia/maho-module-category-attributes
description: Admin UI to create and manage custom category attributes for Maho. Add text/textarea/date/yes-no/dropdown/multiselect/image attributes, assign them to category-edit tabs (attribute groups) with a built-in tab manager, manage dropdown/multiselect options in a grid, and have the attributes render on the category edit page under their tab via Maho's native group rendering. Replaces the legacy Delta_Deltacats extension and the Mango "Custom Category Attributes" feature set.
